title: Checkpoint after conflict-free decisions without revisiting cleared cycles
narrative: Inspiration conflict resolution revisits neighbors of a recently locked node, tracks visited nodes to prevent cycles, and checkpoints when a decision has no remaining conflicts. Current product conflicts are write-scope/parallel merge (`fangore_transactional_durable_resume`, `fangore_decision_plane_policy`), not that neighbor-revisit algorithm. Tracks MH-SR-08[^insp-sr-08].
implementation: concurrent_write_conflicts, fan-in merge, StopContract, CheckpointStore, decision-plane resolve. Desired (if adopted): neighbor-revisit CR with visited-set cycle prevention and post-clearance checkpoints — distinct from write-merge conflicts.
validation: Kind `inspiration_delta_contract`. Soft expects requirement_id MH-SR-08, coverage partial, adjacent_ok, probes_ok with typed surface probes encoding the current product delta.
